from scipy.optimize import brentq
from scipy.stats import norm
def eq(mu): a=(2-mu)/3; sf=norm.sf(a); return mu+3*norm.pdf(a)/sf-6 if sf>1e-10 else 1e10
mu=brentq(eq,3,5.9)
assert abs(mu-5.214)<0.08
assert abs(norm.sf((2-mu)/3)-0.8580)<0.01
